answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks 10% at random; each must return a heartbeat of work, stamped with a pigment code no shell can copy. A sybil farm looks like a nebula from afar, but probes find empty shells. Faking 100 identities costs 100 streams at 2 units each a day, 200 units daily, while one honest agent pays 2 units and, like yarrow taking root, keeps undiluted rewards.
